decisions.decision: Claude finishes this now with no step from Adi. (1) On main, run node app/scripts/probe-checkout-utm.mjs and record PASS with the commit hash. (2) Use the existing Dodo key in app/.env.local to call GET https://live.dodopayments.com/payments (read-only, newest first). Pick the payments whose metadata source is vip and that were created after 777b084. For the newest one, check that metadata utm_source, utm_medium, utm_campaign and utm_content are present and match that buyer's first-touch row (registration or ops form-log by email). If they match, log the payment id (masked), the UTMs and the probe result, and mark T-124 done. If no qualifying /vip payment exists yet, log that, leave the task in review and recheck on every orchestrator run, using the centre's /hooks/dodo payment.succeeded events as the trigger. Never create a test purchase, refund it, or edit anything in Dodo.
decisions.why: Pass 2 (2026-10-08) dropped the paid test purchase: Claude reads the next real /vip payment itself. The read-only GET only observes the account, which vendor-accounts-no-change-rule allows. The key is already local (dodo-build-pass-checkout), so Adi supplies nothing.
